initial:
Use case: ui-mockup. Create one exquisitely finished, straight-on mobile app screen for Hangul Sori, an actual Korean-learning app. Portrait composition precisely 402:874, rendered at high resolution; no phone device bezel, no photographic room, no floating presentation board. All controls and the complete five-tab row must fit in one visible screen at normal type size.
Visual direction: tactile Korean craft, deep organic jade green textile/paper background, warm ivory fibrous hanji, restrained polished brass rims, believable paper thickness and soft contact shadows. Elegant MaruBuri-like Korean serif and Lora German typography, crisp legible live-text appearance. Content is dominant. Lighting is consistent upper-left, luxurious but restrained. Header shares the approved family: small HANGUL SORI wordmark, modest ivory back chevron at left, small brass settings gear at right, large centered title "Meine Wörter" and a fine brass divider. Leave a small empty slot beside the wordmark for later insertion of the exact canonical cloud PNG; do not invent or redraw a cloud/logo.
Distinct card mechanic: ONE unbound two-sided memory card resting in a shallow jade card stand, with a discreet blank second card edge behind it and a gently lifted lower-right paper corner suggesting a flip. Do not use a bound book, scroll, quiz plaque, answer-list stack, matching grid, rings, keyboard, coffee props, character, or themed illustration for the word. The Korean/meaning and real card controls define the design.
Keep standard 48dp hit areas for every enabled control and at least16dp clear from bottom action shadows to navigation. Main learning text >=20dp, German body >=16dp. Under header show passive progress, a compact readable "Umschrift" option and "1×" speech-speed control; no new CEFR selector or score. Card instruction "Tippen zum Umdrehen". A separate small speaker control belongs to the card, without covering text. Below card show two separate engraved controls "Umdrehen" and "Teilen"; below these the three stable self-assessment actions "Nicht gewusst", "Überspringen", "Gewusst!". No heart button, bookmark, new save action, lives, coins, invented reward or completed-round message. Dark ink on cream labels and ivory on jade labels. Bottom fixed five sculpted image-only tabs: calendar, open book, game controller SELECTED, Korean hanok gate, three community figures. No visible text under tabs. Maintain the user's jade/gold canonical icon family; generated icons remain visual proposal placeholders for exact canonical file insertion during Figma implementation.
This is a review-only three-record custom pack, not a claim about user progress. Romanization setting is ON BACK: fronts hide romanization, reverse shows it. No translations or examples may leak onto an unrevealed front. Do not place labels A/B/C on the app. Produce only this one full screen, no explanations or annotation panels. Exact visible texts must be spelled correctly.
A / first unrevealed card. Passive progress "1 / 3". Dominant Korean text exactly "도서관", large but comfortably padded in center of the card. The meaning Bibliothek and all examples are HIDDEN and must not appear anywhere. A quiet small "Bedeutung aufdecken" hint may accompany the existing flip affordance; primary action remains Umdrehen, no additional button. "Nicht gewusst" and "Gewusst!" must be visibly disabled (muted but readable); "Überspringen", "Umdrehen" and "Teilen" enabled. The card feels calm, tangible and ready to turn, not a correct-answer result.

Part of speech: "Nomen"
Word romanization: "[naeyongjeungmyeong]"
Korean example (large readable Korean, natural whole-word line breaks): "수리를 요청한 내용을 남기기 위해 집주인에게 내용증명을 보냈어요."
